glance.title: Krüger Motor Oil — an inside view
glance.lead: German engineering, R&D in Stuttgart, production in Germany. Krüger oils are chosen by vehicle manufacturers and fleet owners in 50+ countries.

history.title: Eight years of engineering precision
history.p1: Krüger was founded in 2017 in Stuttgart — the city that went down in history as the birthplace of the automobile and the heart of German engineering.
history.p2: From the very first litre we pursued a single goal: to produce lubricants that meet the strictest OEM requirements and perform in any operating conditions — from Arctic frost to desert heat, from city traffic to quarry machinery.
history.p3: Today the Krüger portfolio comprises more than 150 products supplied to 50+ countries worldwide.

production.title: Manufactured in Germany
production.p1: All our products are manufactured at plants in Germany. This lets us control quality at every stage — from the selection of base oils and additives through to filling the final packaging.
production.p2: Production is certified to ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environment) and ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety). Every batch undergoes laboratory testing before it is shipped to the customer.

rd.title: Laboratory and development
rd.p1: Our R&D centre in Stuttgart develops new formulations, tests products on test benches and in real-world conditions, and adapts lubricants to the requirements of specific OEM partners.
rd.p2: We invest in research consistently — because engine and transmission technology never stands still, and oil has to evolve with it.

geo.title: Presence in 50+ countries
geo.p1: From Germany and Austria to Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Turkey and the Middle East — Krüger works with distributors and partners across five continents. Our regional network keeps delivery times consistent and technical support close at hand.

intro.p1: a German manufacturer of premium lubricants for the automotive and industrial sectors. Headquarters and R&D centre are based in Stuttgart, with production at certified plants in Germany.
intro.p2: We develop oils to the requirements of leading vehicle manufacturers: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche, Audi, Ford, Volvo, MAN, Scania, Renault, Toyota and Hyundai — all 12 OEMs have confirmed that our formulations are compatible with their engineering systems.
intro.p3: A portfolio of 150+ products covers six market segments: passenger cars, commercial vehicles, electric vehicles, industry, agriculture and forestry, construction and earthmoving equipment. Production is certified to ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environment) and ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety).
intro.p4: In 8 years Krüger has grown into a distribution network spanning five continents with a presence in 50+ countries. Every litre is the result of German engineering, laboratory control and continuous OEM testing.

vision.title: Vision & mission
vision.lead: Why we exist and where we are heading.
vision.ctaText: Learn about our commitments to customers, partners and the environment.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To become the benchmark for lubricants in Europe and emerging markets, delivering German-quality products to everyone who needs reliable engine and equipment protection — from the private motorist to heavy industry.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To produce lubricants that extend the life of machinery, protect engines and help businesses operate without downtime. Every drop of Krüger is the result of German engineering and years of research.

values.title: Quality without compromise
values.text: Meeting ACEA, API, JASO, GOST and OEM requirements is our baseline, not our goal. Every batch undergoes laboratory testing.

values.title: Technology
values.text: We invest in R&D so that our products perform in the most advanced engines — from hybrids to fully electric powertrains.

values.title: Partnership
values.text: We build long-term relationships with dealers, vehicle manufacturers and corporate clients. Our partners' growth is our growth.

values.title: Responsibility
values.text: Environmentally sound base oils, recycling of used lubricants and a lower carbon footprint are part of our operating strategy.

commitments.title: Our commitments
commitments.lead: Six areas in which we keep our word.
commitments.docsText: PDS, SDS, OEM approvals and environmental certificates are available for every Krüger product.

items.title: To our customers
items.text: Quality assurance, transparent specifications, product selection support and technical consultancy — at every stage.

items.title: To our partners
items.text: Reliable supply, marketing support, staff training and joint development in regional markets.

items.title: To the environment
items.text: Use of biodegradable components, a used-oil recycling programme and lower CO₂ emissions at every stage of production.

items.title: To our employees
items.text: Safe working conditions, continuous training and development, and support for engineering initiatives.

items.title: To society
items.text: Support for engineering education, sponsorship of motorsport and technical projects, and social initiatives in the regions where we operate.

items.title: To standards
items.text: ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environment), ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety), plus OEM approvals from the world's leading vehicle manufacturers.
